stories.title: Vehicle stop in Douglas County ends with 2 arrested
stories.summary: Lincoln Avenue, between Interstate 25 and South Oswego Street, was closed Monday morning due to police activity in the area in Douglas County.

stories.title: Pardoned turkeys to live full life at Colorado animal sanctuary
stories.summary: Four turkeys are spared from the Thanksgiving table by Gov. Polis and will enjoy a full life at a Colorado sanctuary.

stories.title: Denver home builders offer rates below 4% as market cools
stories.summary: Homebuilders are enticing buyers with financing incentives, offering rates below 4% to counter the slower market.

stories.title: Excavation starts on $1.8B Cherry Creek project
stories.summary: Cherry Creek West will have 840 residences, 600,000 square feet of office space, and 100,000 square feet of retail when complete.

stories.title: 42 drone shows planned in Denver
stories.summary: Denver's skyline will dazzle with 42 nightly holiday drone shows by Brightflight, featuring 600 drones in festive animations.

stories.title: Smashburger closes Denver metro restaurant
stories.summary: A Smashburger spokesperson said all employees at the Parker Road restaurant have been transitioned to other locations.

stories.title: Advanced snowmaking system assists World Cup ski racing return to Copper Mountain
stories.summary: The world’s fastest men on skis return to Copper Mountain for World Cup downhill racing, thanks to an upgraded snowmaking system.

stories.title: Denver street closed as 69-year-old water main rupture affects 8 properties
stories.summary: S. Holly Street, between E. Evans Ave. and E. Iliff Ave., is closed as Denver Water fixes a broken cast iron water main.

stories.title: 'Those fans are crazy loud': Fernando Mendoza says Broncos fans led to Raiders miscommunication
stories.summary: Rookie quarterback Fernando Mendoza was poised but not perfect in his first NFL road start as the Raiders lost 38-24 to the Denver Broncos.

stories.title: Denver weather: Fog possible early Monday; warming trend for Thanksgiving week
stories.summary: Denver will experience chilly weather starting with fog and freezing fog on Monday morning, warming slightly through the week.

stories.title: ‘Miss Peggy,’ a lifelong CU Buffaloes fan, celebrating 102
stories.summary: Peggy Coppom said she hoped players remember her as a supporter. “I want them to think I was a good fan, had somebody who cheered for them,” she said.

stories.title: Eldora Mountain announces opening day
stories.summary: Eldora Mountain will kick off its 2026–27 ski and snowboard season on Tuesday.
